naya.summary: MAXIS is the design/execution quality standard: preserve working systems, establish canonical source of truth, use evidence, and continuously improve toward an exceptional human experience.
lessons: Quality is an operating system, not a final polish pass.
Protect proven green state while improving the weakest boundary.

human.summary: MAXIS means we do not settle for something that merely works. We keep the good parts, fix the weak parts, verify the result, and keep raising the standard.
lessons: Preserve what works while improving what does not.
The user experience is the final measure of technical quality.

evidence: Legacy human vision was read and migrated into the canonical event store.
